description:
Shown in the suburb report as the 'Median Rent' chart tab in the Market section.

Full median weekly-rent observation history for the suburb, including
2024 and 2025 where the suburb has coverage. Older observations are
generally month-end and recent observations can be weekly; this is not a
uniformly quarterly series. Values are advertised median AUD per week.

**Price: 30¢ per call.**
name: suburbs_market_median_rent_series
